open_items: ECB gateway_issue -> degraded, new as of cycle 1240. Gateway data and direct data both failing (gateway: 'provider unreachable' after 30.6s; direct: ReadTimeout after 30.5s). Live recheck just now reproduced it: a plain text/csv direct call to /data/EXR/D.USD.EUR.SP00.A?lastNObservations=1 (the exact call config.py already sends) took 31.4s and returned ECB's own HTTP 504 error page. The same series via SDMx-JSON answered 200 in 0.8s. This contradicts the previous run's hypothesis (that our gateway hangs on the SDMx-CSV Accept header and never reaches a fast text/csv retry) since text/csv direct now also 504s. Reclassified as provider-side, not a gateway bug. Across cycles 1238-1240 three different check combinations have failed and each recovered before the next failed differently (1238: gateway metadata + direct json; 1239: healthy; 1240: gateway data + direct data). See incidents.md cycle 1240 entry. Do not action a gateway code change on the old Accept-header theory; watch for a cycle where gateway fails while a simultaneous direct text/csv call to the same series succeeds, which would support a real gateway retry bug.

ESTAT healthy -> gateway_issue -> healthy, flapped at cycle 1239 only ('gateway metadata: Error:'), already resolved by cycle 1240. Recorded per the skill's flap rule. Underlying error text was truncated by the monitor to 'Error:' and cannot be recovered now.
ILO provider_down -> healthy, recovered by cycle 1235 (reported last run). No new occurrence this run; still tracked as chronic Cloudflare-403 flapping (cycles 1222, 1232, 1234 previously).
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1240. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
134 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run. Still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug noted previously: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status. Not re-confirmed this run since no contract-only state occurred, but still believed true.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO/OECD encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
